what: Plan does not specify how to strip embedded larch:plan from scope-anchor source text
scenario_or_breakage: Ad-hoc stripping can miss malformed marker pairs and leave prior plan text in plan-review-scope-anchor.txt, so reviewers/voters still treat stale plan content as binding issue scope
suggested_fix: Reuse the same MARK_START/MARK_END rules as scripts/plan-block-read.sh: delete the inclusive start/end marker lines and everything between them; keep only exterior body (no new helper required)
